scope: 32 alternate-period rows plus sibling frozen v3 dossiers, all on already counted stars; no discovery claim and not a new all-survey validation.

ranked_recommendations.reason: 28/28 positive raw events, SNR 13.25, depth 438 ppm, broadly consistent across apertures. Current R=2.40763 Rsun, M=2.85 Msun, Teff=10942 K. True-period half-phase secondary is -0.58 sigma and selected other phase 3.19 sigma.
ranked_recommendations.concerns: Odd/even 3.21 sigma; grazing/long ingress. QLP x centroid is 12.14 sigma but only 0.000684 pixel. Stellar-companion, gravity-darkening/rotation and blend alternatives remain. The 1.347 d secondary alone does not reject a 0.673 d planet.
ranked_recommendations.next: Retrieve independent sectors, common-ephemeris parity depths/shapes, Gaia/SIMBAD/VSX/literature and source pixels; compare planetary and binary models.

ranked_recommendations.reason: The longer alias restores three consistent raw dips, SNR 15.44; the shorter alias mixes strong and shallow events and falls to 4.53. Current R=1.08849 Rsun, M=1.02 Msun, planetary depth scale possible.
ranked_recommendations.concerns: Only three events, ingress fraction 0.453; aperture and centroid warnings. Half-phase and selected other-phase tests each sample only one event, so secondary absence remains weakly constrained.
ranked_recommendations.next: Independent sectors, additional eclipses, difference-image source and aperture dilution model.

ranked_recommendations.reason: Eight raw events, SNR 14.89, odd/even 0.50 sigma; current R=0.919909 Rsun and fitted undiluted size near 0.86 Rjup.
ranked_recommendations.concerns: Small/raw/large depths 2273/7762/11708 ppm and x centroid 18.74 sigma; true-period secondary 2.93 sigma raw and 4.09 sigma large aperture. Double-period secondary is expected from any repeating short-period dip.
ranked_recommendations.next: Independent-sector secondary tests and source pixels; centroid/aperture warnings alone do not falsify it.

ranked_recommendations.reason: 18 raw events, SNR 19.80, odd/even 0.79 sigma; true-P secondary 1.45 sigma half phase and 2.71 sigma selected phase. Current R=1.25167 Rsun gives fitted undiluted size around 1.50 Rjup.
ranked_recommendations.concerns: Small/raw/large depths 4443/12017/17892 ppm; y centroid -0.01542 pixel at 32.3 sigma. A blended stellar source is an important unresolved alternative.
ranked_recommendations.next: Independent sectors, source pixels, full-orbit and parity-shape comparison of short-period planet vs equal eclipses at twice the period.

ranked_recommendations.reason: The 9.158 d alias is twice the 4.57986 d repeating dips. At least four deep dips are visible in raw flux, but frozen local fits retain three. Current R=0.83794 Rsun, M=0.92 Msun.
ranked_recommendations.concerns: Zero recorded secondary at 9.158 d is untested coverage: the early sampled deep dip is excluded by a quality gap 0.062499881 d barely above three median cadences; two later secondary windows have no good points. Coherent raw 4.58 d modulation is 2371 +/-126 ppm, 18.8 sigma, favoring stellar variability/blend/ellipsoidal alternatives.
ranked_recommendations.next: Independent sectors, documented gap-tolerance sensitivity kept separate from frozen v3, source attribution and full-orbit models.

ranked_recommendations.reason: Five consistent primary dips, raw SNR 11.60, odd/even 0.29 sigma, current R=1.20506 Rsun.
ranked_recommendations.concerns: Selected other-phase eclipse is 4.97 sigma raw, 6.40 sigma large aperture, from only two events; source warnings. It is not presently secondary-free.

ranked_recommendations.reason: Longer original period has 14 raw events, SNR 12.12 and no strong secondary; current R=1.20593 Rsun.
ranked_recommendations.concerns: The 0.67684 d alternate has excessive duty cycle and odd/even differences. Original longer solution still has depth-aperture dependence and x centroid 21.2 sigma.
ranked_recommendations.next: Independent sectors at original longer period and pixel source checks if higher priorities fail.

independent_common_mode_check.method: Use QUALITY==0 and finite TIME, KSPSAP_FLUX, SAP_FLUX, align shared CADENCENO with numpy.intersect1d(return_indices=True), compute numpy.corrcoef before and after scipy.ndimage.median_filter(size=97), default reflect mode; exploratory common-mode diagnostic.
independent_common_mode_check.interpretation: Strong shared high-frequency signal nearly two degrees apart favors instrumental or optical contamination. Source unidentified; other planets around these stars are not excluded.

secondary_coverage_edge_case.frozen_status: No usable local secondary measurement; zero stored SNR is unavailable, not measured absence.
